Usable parameter names

Source: R/confint.R, R/methods-draws.R
variables.Rd

The names that hypothesis() expressions (and set_prior() targeting) accept: fixed-effect coefficients under their vcov() names with parentheses stripped, natural-scale random-effect summaries (sd_<group>__<term>, cor_<group>__<t1>__<t2>), and sigma when the residual SD is a scalar. The brms spelling; for sampled fits, variables() on the frm_sample() result lists the draw columns instead.

Usage

variables(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'frmtmb_fit'
variables(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'frmtmb_draws'
variables(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A frmtmb_fit or frmtmb_draws.

...

Unused.

Value

A character vector.

Examples

dd <- data.frame(x = rnorm(60), g = factor(rep(1:6, 10)))
dd$y <- rnorm(60, 1 + 0.5 * dd$x + rnorm(6, 0, 0.5)[dd$g], 1)
fit <- frm(bf(y ~ x + (1 | g)) + gaussian(), data = dd)
variables(fit)
#> [1] "Intercept"       "x"               "sigma_Intercept" "sd_g__Intercept"
#> [5] "sigma"
